A straight chain of one-nested-table-per-cell tables renders as pipe tables, not a broken layout list

```rust title="Rust"
use html_to_markdown_rs::convert;
use html_to_markdown_rs::ConversionOptions;

fn main() {
    let html = r#"<table><tr><td><table><tr><td><table><tr><td>leaf</td></tr></table></td></tr></table></td></tr></table>"#;
    let options: ConversionOptions = Default::default();
    let result = convert(html, Some(options.clone()));
    println!("{:?}", result);
}
```
